meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 当用户输入 /caveman-stats 时，Claude 本身不计算，而是由后台 hook 从会话日志读取真实 token 用量和估算节省，直接显示给用户；输出还包含规则开销与净节省的估算行。
howto.when: 当用户在对话中输入斜杠命令 /caveman-stats 时触发。

say.note: 立即显示当前会话的 token 用量与估算节省。

howto.what_en: When the user types /caveman-stats, Claude itself does not compute anything; a background hook reads the real token usage and estimated savings from the session log and shows them immediately. The output includes estimated rule overhead and net savings lines.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user enters the slash command /caveman-stats in the conversation.

say_en.note: Shows real token usage and estimated savings for the session.
